create_config_mimi: create a MimiConfig instance to initialize the configuration for the Mimi audio model
configure_mimi_model: configure Mimi model parameters including upsampling_ratios, num_quantizers, and hidden_size for audio encoding
validate_mimi_config: validate MimiConfig architecture constraints such as num_semantic_quantizers being less than num_quantizers
compute_encodec_frame_rate: compute the encodec_frame_rate property from upsampling_ratios and sampling_rate for the Mimi model
compute_frame_size: compute the frame_size property by multiplying encoder conv strides for the Mimi model
